Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, and period-aligned reconciliation.

Contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecast, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because matching-period costs, commitments, and an approved learning threshold are absent. Infrastructure spend is not calculable because operations sweeps have no results and no infrastructure-cost ledger is supplied.

Continue containment-only execution. Complete or justifiably close the retained saveusfarms.com failure by 2026-09-30T07:30Z before queue admission reopens. Require dated ownership, root cause or close rationale, isolated validation, rollback, release/security boundary, attribution and measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not retry unchanged work or admit new implementation requests.
